title: Clearer NVQ activity navigation
details: The Level 3 Trowel AC arch no longer uses the old P/T theme view and now follows the same A-E Main Category > Sub-category > Activity structure used for evidence
Section E practical activities now open visible evidence activity tiles such as E2.1.1, E2.1.2, E2.1.3 and E2.1.4 instead of forcing a hidden stage-by-stage workflow
Each practical evidence tile keeps its own Photo or Video prompts and saves underneath the overarching practical activity
The official AC mapping remains attached to the overarching activity and all learner routes retain their complete qualification AC coverage
The approved camera, photo/video saving, guided audio, OTJ, Standards courses and the rest of Evia are unchanged
summary: Evia v151 removes P/T navigation and makes practical NVQ evidence activities directly selectable.
